about_the_game:
The Boat

Perfectly balanced boating experience for 4 survivors: Round.

Steer clear of enemies and explore the map for goods by pedaling in every direction you want at the same time.

1 boot 4 feet, as it should be.

Bait Motel

There is only one place on this forsaken water, and it is this damned hotel.

It might be creaky, it might be too expensive, but at least you can restock here.

Late Night Fee

The rent fee will only go up. If you can't cough up the coins, you can't get to safety for the night (isn't it always night?!).

Survive

Eat, drink, stay warm, steer clear of monsters. Your stamina is your life.

Hands to feed

As if paying a hefty fee every night for subpar service was not enough, you also have to pay the hand(s) or they will get cranky.

short_description: Friday Night Fishing is a 4 player coop game. Your boat sinks at the mysterious island of Creepy Shores. There is only one thing here, the Bait Motel. To enter, you have to pay a fee every night. Go out and collect the rent fee by fishing on the surrounding waters. Survive the night and pay the fee!
